product.description: Poppy și Sam se hotărăsc să meargă în excursie cu cortul. Toate bune, până când vaca Daisy vrea să li se alăture și ea... Află totul citind această poveste încântătoare, iar apoi poţi rezolva activităţile de la sfârșitul cărţii.   Prima mea lectură este o colecție special creată pentru a-i ghida pas cu pas pe preșcolari și pe școlari în aventura cititului. Formatul accesibil, textele ilustrate și adaptate la nivelul de înțelegere al vârstei, succesul de care se bucură aceste cărți în lumea întreagă și premiile primite îi motivează pe copii să-și cultive interesul pentru lectură. # Farm Stories: A Night with the Tent â I Read with Help (Level 1) Book

Get your child excited about literacy milestones with *Povesti de la ferma*. This delightful Level 1 reader from Litera is perfectly designed to guide preschoolers and early elementary students through the wonderful adventure of reading. Perfect for beginner readers, this book combines a heartwarming story with structured learning activities.

Explore the magic of friendship as Poppy and Sam embark on an exciting camping trip with a tent. Their plans take an unexpected turn when Daisy the cow wants to join the fun! Children will follow the engaging narrative while improving their comprehension skills through the story, followed by helpful activities at the end of the book.

## Why Choose Literaâs Guided Reading Series?

This collection represents more than just a storybook; it is a carefully curated educational journey. The entire series is designed to give your child step-by-step confidence in their reading abilities.

*   **Accessible Format:** Featuring beautifully illustrated and age-appropriate texts, the book ensures that the material matches the current developmental level of the reader.
*   **Proven Success:** Litera's books are recognized globally for helping children cultivate a lasting interest in literature and learning.
*   **Structured Progression:** The series is broken down into distinct levels, ensuring steady growth:
    *   Level 1: For ages 5-6 years.
    *   Level 2 & 3: For ages 6-7 years.
    *   Level 4: For ages 7-8 years.
    *   Levels 5 & 6: For ages 8-9 years.

The Level 1 edition is the ideal starting point for little learners who are just beginning their reading adventure!

## Product Details and Specifications

**Title:** Povesti de la ferma. O noapte cu cortul. Citesc cu ajutor (Nivelul 1)

The inclusion of comprehension exercises at the end of the book reinforces vocabulary and improves overall reading retention, making it a comprehensive learning tool for young readers.

### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Is this book appropriate for very young children?**
This Level 1 book is specifically recommended for preschoolers and early elementary students aged 5-6 years who are beginning to read with the assistance of an adult or teacher.

**What does "I Read with Help" mean?**
It indicates that the book is designed as a guided reader, meaning the text is scaffolded and includes activities to build confidence and reinforce learning after reading the main story.
